subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): canonical IDisposable + fix ProtocolBase.Dispose (S3881/S2930)
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): canonical IDisposable + fix ProtocolBase.Dispose (S3881/S2930)

ProtocolBase.Dispose(bool) was private, non-virtual, and inverted
(`if (disposing) return;` disposed nothing on an explicit Dispose). Make it
`protected virtual` and correct the logic so tmrReconnect is disposed on Dispose()
- a real fix that benefits all protocols.

ProtocolSshDotNet now overrides Dispose(bool) to dispose its owned resources at
end-of-life: both CancellationTokenSources (including the object-lifetime
_errorCancellationSource), the shell stream, tunnel manager, and SSH client. Dispose
methods used here are idempotent, so no generic catch is needed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: ProtocolBase.Dispose is already virtual and corrected in our fork. The SSH_DotNet protocol files are not present on our main branch.
